title: Java app health
description: JVM health, event thread freezes, uncaught exceptions, and application logs from the Java ui-agent. One line per app and environment.

panels.title: Heap used (bytes)
panels.description: jvm.memory.used for the heap, max per 5 minutes. A line that only goes up is a leak candidate.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minute') AS "x_axis_1", concat(service_name, ' @ ', deployment_environment_name) AS "breakdown_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "jvm_memory_used" WHERE jvm_memory_type = 'heap' AND (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

panels.title: Process CPU (0 to 1)
panels.description: process.cpu.utilization sampled every 10 seconds, max per 5 minutes.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minute') AS "x_axis_1", concat(service_name, ' @ ', deployment_environment_name) AS "breakdown_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "process_cpu_utilization" WHERE (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

panels.title: Event thread worst latency (ms)
panels.description: Longest time a 1 second ping waited for the Swing or JavaFX event thread, per 5 minutes. Above 500 ms the UI visibly stalls.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minute') AS "x_axis_1", concat(service_name, ' @ ', deployment_environment_name) AS "breakdown_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "ui_event_thread_latency_max" WHERE (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

panels.title: Live threads
panels.description: jvm.thread.count, max per 5 minutes. A count that climbs with use is a thread leak.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minute') AS "x_axis_1", concat(service_name, ' @ ', deployment_environment_name) AS "breakdown_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "jvm_thread_count" WHERE (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

panels.title: Event thread freezes per hour
panels.description: Times the event thread was blocked for longer than the freeze threshold (500 ms).

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS "x_axis_1", concat(service_name, ' @ ', deployment_environment_name) AS "breakdown_1", count(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "java_logs" WHERE kind = 'freeze' AND (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

panels.title: Log errors and warnings per hour
panels.description: Application log records at ERROR or WARN (JUL, log4j, logback, and stderr).

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS "x_axis_1", concat(service_name, ' @ ', deployment_environment_name) AS "breakdown_1", count(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "java_logs" WHERE severity IN ('ERROR', 'WARN') AND kind <> 'freeze' AND kind <> 'freeze_end' AND (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

panels.title: Recent freezes: what the event thread was doing
panels.description: One row per freeze with the top frame of the event thread stack. The message names the control when a click or key just before the stall armed one.

queries.query: SELECT service_name AS app, deployment_environment_name AS env, _timestamp AS at, body AS what, substr(regexp_replace(exception_stacktrace, '^[^\n]*\n\s*', ''), 1, 160) AS top_frame FROM "java_logs" WHERE kind = 'freeze' AND (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Time an operator was at the console
panels.description: Seconds a page window was in front and someone moved the mouse, used the keyboard, or brought the window forward, per session. A window left open with no input for 3 minutes stops counting. This is not time-on-page.

queries.query: SELECT service AS app, env, session_id, round(sum(view_time_spent) / 1e9) AS seconds_present, count(*) AS stretches FROM "ui_views" WHERE type = 'presence' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY service, env, session_id ORDER BY seconds_present DESC

panels.title: Controls that exist
panels.description: Buttons, menus, tabs, and fields the agent saw, once per page and label. A row here was not necessarily used. An empty label is a control with no text and no tooltip.

queries.query: SELECT service AS app, env, view_url AS page, body AS control FROM "ui_views" WHERE type = 'inventory' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY service, env, view_url, body ORDER BY app, page, control LIMIT 500

panels.title: Uncaught exceptions
panels.description: Exceptions that reached the default handler, grouped by app, page, and message.

queries.query: SELECT application_id AS app, env, view_url AS page, error_source AS thread, substr(error_message, 1, 140) AS message, count(*) AS errors, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS last_seen_utc FROM "ui_views" WHERE type = 'error' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY app, env, page, thread, message ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Top log errors and warnings
panels.description: Grouped by logger and message. source = stderr means it was printed, not logged.

queries.query: SELECT service_name AS app, severity, kind AS source, logger, substr(body, 1, 140) AS message, count(*) AS n, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS last_seen_utc FROM "java_logs" WHERE severity IN ('ERROR', 'WARN') AND kind <> 'freeze_end' AND (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY app, severity, source, logger, message ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Log sources captured per app
panels.description: Where the log rows came from: app_log (JUL, log4j, logback), stdout, stderr, freeze, uncaught_exception. An app with only stdout rows is not using a logging framework the agent hooks.

queries.query: SELECT service_name AS app, deployment_environment_name AS env, kind AS source, count(*) AS rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'ERROR') AS errors, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'WARN') AS warnings FROM "java_logs" WHERE (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY app, env, source ORDER BY app, env, source
